info.title: OppRadar API
info.description: Backend for OppRadar — opportunities in, matches out.

post.description:
'Try the demo instead': a session for the shared read-only demo account.

The frontend passes the tokens to `supabase.auth.setSession(...)`.

get.description: Whole profile + onboarding progress (wizard, review screen, 'Save & exit' resume).

delete.description: Settings -> Danger zone: permanently delete the account, its files and data.

patch.description:
Settings -> Privacy & AI (history retention) and Agent & sources.
Notification rules and consents use PATCH /me/onboarding/alerts.
Step 2 · Education (experiences/certificates use their own endpoints).

post.description: 'Finish setup': 422 with the list of missing required fields, or the completed profile.

get.description: Counts for the dashboard tiles and tabs.

post.description: 'Start my agent': recorded now; scanning starts once the AI matcher ships.

get.description: 'For you' (types chosen in onboarding), 'Closing soon' (7 days) or 'Saved'.

put.description: 'Not interested': hidden from 'For you' and 'Closing soon'.

get.description: Last 30 days, newest first, plus the unread count (the bell uses limit=5).

post.description: Mark the given notifications read, or all of them when `ids` is omitted.

schema.title: Response List Applications Me Applications Get

put.description: Create or update the application for an opportunity (status, reference, notes).

get.description: Current plan (always Free until payments launch) and any early-access reservation.

put.description: Reserve early access / join the Clubs waitlist. Nothing is charged.

post.description:
Accept a PDF and start extracting it.

Progress: poll GET /documents/{id} or listen to the `document:progress` socket event.

get.description: One document; for a finished CV, `prefill` holds the values for the onboarding steps.
Past turns, oldest first — empty when the chat-history consent is off.

post.description:
One question -> the new user + assistant turns. Read-only for the demo:
it answers but stores nothing.

AgentSettings.title: AgentSettings
AgentSettings.description:
Settings -> Agent & sources. Stored as profiles.agent_settings (jsonb);
honoured by the scan pipeline once it ships.

CVPrefill.title: CVPrefill
CVPrefill.description: Values found in a CV, shaped like the onboarding steps they pre-fill.

EducationStep-Input.title: EducationStep
EducationStep-Input.description: Step 2 · Education & experience (experiences/certificates have their own CRUD).

EducationStep-Output.title: EducationStep
EducationStep-Output.description: Step 2 · Education & experience (experiences/certificates have their own CRUD).

Me.title: Me
Me.description: Everything the onboarding wizard and the profile review screen show.

MyOpportunity.title: MyOpportunity
MyOpportunity.description:
An opportunity plus this user's state. Match score / eligibility join
here when the AI matcher ships (see docs/ai-interface.md).

SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch
SettingsPatch.description: PATCH /me/settings: Privacy & AI retention + Agent & sources.
